base_measurement.live_tree_control: The same pathspec commit measured against the live checkout (not a clone) cost 203ms leg CPU, 0 spawns: the sparse shared clone costs about twice the live tree (434ms), so the local rows are an upper bound for this repo.
base_measurement.not_reproduced: The Mac 08:34:26Z 3178ms is NOT reproduced at this repo's own index size (321-434ms). It is reproduced in order of magnitude only by inflating the index; the pinned rows establish the mechanism and its scaling, not the machine-a's repo.

attribution.method: time.process_time brackets around every function of the guard modules and coordinator_core.git, plus a line tracer on check_validate_commit's own frame charged to the nearest preceding '# Check N' banner (replay's monkeypatch layer; no cProfile). Third, instrumented call per row: inflated, read as shares.
attribution.dominant_cost: In-process Python, no git spawn: coordinator_core/git/git_state.py::_parse_index_bytes (full index parse, read_index(fresh=True)) called 3x per guard call, plus _git_tree_facts.py::_nest_index and ::_tree_sha (whole-index tree hashing) inside _compute_staged_name_status, which runs 2x per guard call. At 500k paths: _parse_index_bytes 1891ms of 2097ms (90%), _nest_index 386ms, _tree_sha exclusive ~600ms, _compute_staged_name_status 1999ms inclusive.
attribution.note_overlap: Check 13 re-derives staged rows via _git_tree_facts after the prelude; the per-region figures are inclusive of callees and the regions overlap in function terms (prelude and Check 13 both land in _compute_staged_name_status).
attribution.constant_cost: Checks 9-11 cost ~150-165ms on every row independent of the commit repo's size: check_schema_version_bump parses the settings-home plugin repo's index (a second repo).
attribution.git_tripwire_unbudgeted: commit_tripwires._run_git calls git.run.run_git outside the 4.0s probe deadline (plan AP1/AP2); this replay saw 0-1 git spawns in the leg, so the unbudgeted spawns are not the cost on these rows.
attribution.spawns: 0 on the rename-free staged shapes, 1 when an A and a D coexist (fallback `git diff --cached --name-status -M`): the spawn count is shape-dependent at base.

premise_verdict: yes: rows built from the machine-a's only recorded property (a mean ~9.8s guard-body CPU, not a queue) reproduce a validate-commit leg over 500ms (2.0-2.1s) and attribute it to in-process index parse and tree hashing that scale with tracked-path count; the machine-a's real tracked-path count is unknown and the 3178ms Mac figure is not reproduced at this repo's size.
